user.title: VTherm inhibition
user.description: Select the Versatile Thermostat that must step back while another device takes over.

data_description.source_entities: Binary sensors, input booleans and switches inhibit when on; climate entities when in one of the modes below. Any active source inhibits.
data_description.climate_hvac_modes: A climate source inhibits while its HVAC mode is one of these.
data_description.activation_delay: Seconds a source must stay active before the VTherm steps back.
data_description.deactivation_delay: Seconds all sources must stay inactive before the VTherm resumes.
data_description.unavailable_grace_period: Seconds the last status is kept while a source is unavailable before it becomes unknown.
data_description.physical_stop_policy: Turn the VTherm's devices off once, or leave them as they are.

error.not_a_vtherm: This entity is not a Versatile Thermostat.
error.source_is_target: The VTherm cannot be its own source.

abort.already_configured: This VTherm already has an inhibition entry.
